_why: The pin of the custom Web export template (tools/site-template.mjs, docs/tools/site-template.md). tools/site.json "template": "custom" is refused until this record is complete: a release asset URL, the SHA-512 of the zip and of the godot.wasm in it, and the build pinned (flags, source, Emscripten, patches: any change is a new flip, Legal RL-199), and the readings measured on the CUSTOM export, each taken on this zip (parity, the signature and collapse clips in both modes, a nightly on the pinned commit, and the frame comparison standard against custom: a frame beyond noise needs the full set in measured.full). The zip is published (GitHub Release web-template-4.7.2-lazy-1, Orb's yes to option (b), 2026-10-28) and pinned below by SHA-512; the readings were taken by Performance on the live pin 257a766c (docs/perf/web-template-readings-2026-10-28.md). The signature clip reduced reads 3 / 3 / 3, over RL-195's 2.5 / 3 / 2, exactly as the STANDARD build does on this pin; Legal's RL-202 lets the custom engine go under this one pin on "no worse than the standard build of the same commit" (measured.standard, every number), through the engineFlip entry in tools/flash/signature-gate.json, until the next pin move or 2026-11-01. These readings are for that pin: a new pin needs them re-taken.

build.flags: platform=web target=template_release threads=no production=yes optimize=size lto=none

_measured_prefix: The release asset is the zip of run 40624057612, the one Performance measured (docs/perf/web-template-2026-10-28.md): 9,861,157 bytes, SHA-512 starting f0b7b0805ef3d63e, the same as the release asset's; so Performance's parity reading carries over to it, and no other reading does.

parity.by: Performance, 2026-10-28, on main 9631fc75 (the engine label differs by design)

signature.by: Performance, 2026-10-28, on the pin 257a766c exported with this template (hook and lock, as the nightly exports it), 1500-tick clips, seed 12345

collapse.by: Performance, 2026-10-28, on the pin 257a766c exported with this template (hook and lock, as the nightly exports it), 1500-tick clips, seed 12345

nightly.by: Performance, 2026-10-28, tools/flash/nightly-seeds.mjs --pin on the custom export (limit 3.5, the owner-approved interim)

frames.bound: tools/flash/compare-frames.mjs per clip, tol 8, floor 0.1%, 1.25 x the worst frame of a second standard capture; worst frame / bound (% of pixels): sig-n 0.000 / 0.100, sig-r 0.000 / 0.100, col-n 0.112 / 0.113, col-r 0.112 / 0.157

standard.by: Performance, 2026-10-28 (docs/perf/web-template-readings-2026-10-28.md): the STANDARD template exported from the same pin through the same exporter, the same clips, seed 12345, 1500 ticks; the signature figures equal Tools' own for this pin (tools/flash/signature-gate.json). Legal RL-202's "no worse" is read against these: every number of the custom reading above equal or lower, or the flip is refused. Not a measurement of the custom zip, so it carries no "template".
